propositions: Six proposed deterministic clarity criteria were validated against 574 closed tickets with signed plan-review attestation; all six criteria trigger false positives on valid historical tickets.
Required canonical section headings (Approach, Scope) are disproved as a hard rule; valid plans encode mechanism via semantic aliases and non-heading compact formats.
Placeholder-phrase detection (check if, TBD lexicon) conflates unresolved design choices with bounded conditional work; many valid tickets express scope in AC rather than Scope headings.
Per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers (verified by) are not required; behavioral assertions without sentinel clauses remain precise oracles that passed both plan-review and completion-verifier.

Edit-set requirements with Scope and file_impact sections fail for read-only analysis and operational work; valid tickets with empty file_impact explicitly state no-edit/output contracts in plan text.

AC conjunction/vague/hedge heuristics cannot distinguish atomic bundled invariants from independent deliverables; testing-shape rules should require negative scenarios only after semantic applicability establishes new user-facing behavior.
